record.name: Peacekeeper
record.description: Peacekeepers are masters of maintaining order and preventing conflicts before they escalate. They excel at creating safe environments, mediating disputes, and using their protective abilities to ensure peace and stability.

subclass_identity_profile.core_fantasy: Protectors of peace and order, Peacekeepers safeguard their allies and communities from harm.

progression_tree.description: You radiate a calming presence, making it more difficult for enemies to become enraged. As you gain levels, your aura becomes stronger.
You can use your action to mediate a dispute between two creatures, attempting to resolve the issue peacefully. The DM determines if you succeed.
You learn to generate force shields around allies, absorbing damage and protecting them from harm.
You become attuned to the Force, allowing you to sense disturbances and anticipate threats.
You become a beacon of hope and peace, drawing allies to you in times of need.

dynamic_visuals.combat_stance: A balanced stance with feet shoulder-width apart, ready to engage or retreat as needed, while maintaining a vigilant gaze around the surroundings.
dynamic_visuals.energy_signature: A soft blue glow emanating from the wearer's armor, pulsing with a calming energy that serves as a beacon of peace and protection

prompt_schema.base_prompt: Peacekeeper standing guard, focused on safeguarding allies in a serene outdoor setting at sunset
contextual_modifiers: Incorporate a subtle gradient effect to enhance the visual depth of the armor's blue glow
Depict the Peacekeeper's expression as contemplative and watchful, conveying their unwavering commitment to protecting others
